output.headline: Buys $66,878.22 of rubber playground tiles from Sof Surfaces for Allendale Elementary
output.summary: The district is buying rubber tiles from Sof Surfaces, Inc. to cover asphalt and help build the new play structure at Allendale Elementary School. output.summary: Musco Sports Lighting will supply and install a modular soccer system at Allendale Elementary School. The Board is declaring that public bidding would be futile, so the district is contracting without a competitive bid. Work is scheduled from August 10, 2023 to February 6, 2024.

output.headline: Approves Oakland High battery system with no upfront cost; $200,000 in fees if tax credit falls short
